papers.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
papers.authors: Neta Shaul, Chao Liu, Arash Vahdat, Julius Berner
papers.intro: 本文提出并行解码蒸馏（PDD），一种基于轨迹的简化、可扩展的蒸馏方法，通过在学习并行解码器一次网络评估中预测多个去噪步骤，实现了对预训练扩散/流匹配模型的快速推理，并支持可变函数评估次数（NFE），在图像和视频生成任务上达到SOTA性能且改善多样性。

papers.title: Schrödinger's Cat: Probabilistic Representation and Prediction of Potential Scene Kinematics
papers.authors: Timy Phan, Jannik Wiese, Björn Ommer
papers.affiliations: CompVis @ LMU Munich, Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)
papers.intro: 本文提出GARFIELD，通过学习一种结构化的时空隐层表示来编码未来运动的概率分布，同时支持高效联合轨迹采样和确定性密度估计，实现比视频生成模型快97倍的轨迹采样和比蒙特卡洛采样快两个数量级的密度估计。

papers.title: MODUS: Decoder-Only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities
papers.authors: Mingqiao Ye, Zhaochong An, Zhitong Gao, Xian Liu, François Fleuret, Chuan Li, Amir Zadeh, Serge Belongie, Afshin Dehghan, Jesse Allardice, David Mizrahi, Oğuzhan Fatih Kar, Roman Bachmann, Amir Zamir
papers.affiliations: EPFL, Apple, University of Copenhagen, CUHK, University of Geneva, Lambda AI
papers.intro: 本文提出Modus，一个纯解码器的任意到任意多模态模型，通过统一的分词方案和分阶段训练策略，在单模型中支持15种1D和2D模态的灵活生成，并与专用模型和多任务基线竞争。

papers.title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA
papers.authors: Carlos Celemin, Benedict Wilkins, Adrián Barahona-Ríos, Saman Zadtootaghaj, Nabajeet Barman
papers.affiliations: Sony Interactive Entertainment, London, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文评估了六种视觉语言模型（VLMs）在零样本设置下对游戏几何裁剪Bug的检测能力，发现模型虽能捕捉视觉线索，但在视觉模糊帧上产生大量误报，表明当前VLMs更适合作为多阶段QA流水线中的高召回候选过滤器，而非独立检测器。

papers.title: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
papers.authors: Chenrui Shi, Yuwei Wu, Yang Liu, Ruining Feng, Zirui Shang, Zhi Gao, Lifeng Fan, Che Sun
papers.affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology; BIGAI; Guangdong Laboratory of Machine Perception and Intelligent Computing, Shenzhen MSU-BIT University; Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于“提出条件-再验证”框架的交互式奖励代理（IRA），它通过调用系统工具、应用工具和GUI工具主动获取并验证后执行环境中的证据，从而准确判断GUI任务是否完成，并引入GUI-RewardBench基准证明其有效性。

papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
papers.authors: Simple AI, :, Yuteng Wei, Jinming Ma, Jiawei Wang, Weitao Zhou, Yushen Zuo, Ke Rui, Minglei Li, Jinhao Zhang, Zhikang Pan, Xiang Wang, Haoran Jia, Huan Du, Zicheng Zeng, Jun Ma, Guiyu Qin, Di Zhang, Xiaofei Li
papers.intro: 本文提出HiFi-UMI系统，通过硬件-软件协同设计大幅提升无机器人UMI数据的保真度（3mm轨迹精度、微秒级同步、超广角六视图），首次证明仅凭高保真无机器人数据进行后训练即可直接部署于真实机器人，并在三个骨干方法上达到与领域内遥操作相当的性能（成功率差异不超过3.1个百分点）。

papers.title: TIGA: Trajectory-Injected Generative Attack against Black-box AIGC Detectors
papers.authors: Xia Du, Zhuosen Bao, Zheng Lin, Jizhe Zhou, Jiawei Lian, Chi-man Pun, Jun Luo, Wei Ni, Symeon Chatzinotas
papers.affiliations: 未明确（整体）——详见第十二节
papers.intro: 提出TIGA，一种无需训练、无需源图像的框架，它通过在单次DDIM采样轨迹中注入代理引导与黑盒方向搜索信息，直接生成能够欺骗黑盒AIGC检测器的高质量对抗图像。

papers.title: Adversarial Deepfake Generation and an Investigation of Purification-Based Adversarial Detection
papers.authors: Junghyun Kim, Seunghyun Kim, Jiyoung Woo
papers.intro: 本文提出一种针对12个检测器的多模型PGD对抗攻击流程用于生成不可感知的深度伪造，并系统研究了基于中值滤波净化的对抗检测方法，发现EFFORT检测器的原始logit差异（|Δlogit|）在多种对抗源上实现0.81-0.98 AUROC，且驳斥了简单骨干保持假说。

papers.title: FLASH: Efficient Impact Fall Detection with Unified Hypergraph State-Space Model
papers.authors: Tresor Y. Koffi, Youssef Mourchid, Yohan Dupuis
papers.intro: FLASH将单矩阵超图表示与Mamba选择性状态空间模型结合，通过生物力学先验构造超边并利用线性时间复杂度的时序建模，实现高效、可解释且可跨数据集泛化的跌倒冲击帧级检测。

papers.title: ANFI: Rethinking Neighbor Feature Interaction in Person Re-ID
papers.authors: Xulin Li, Yan Lu, Bin Liu, Jiaze Li, Qinhong Yang, Tao Gong, Qi Chu, Nenghai Yu
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China（中国科学技术大学）；Anhui Province Key Laboratory of Digital Security（安徽省数字安全重点实验室）；The Chinese University of Hong Kong（香港中文大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出自适应邻居特征交互（Adaptive Neighbor Feature Interaction, ANFI）方法，通过联合建模亲和关系（正权重）与差异关系（负权重），并采用样本级自适应加权，显式抑制噪声邻居对Re-ID特征表示的负面影响。

papers.title: CADER: Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning for Long-Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jinlong Yang, Wenhao Zhang, Kuanwei Lin, Sijie Cheng
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Northwestern Polytechnical University; School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: CADER是一个训练-free的长视频推理框架，通过置信度（logit margin）将样本分为简单/困难两类：高置信样本直接早期退出，低置信样本进入由时间裁剪、轻量语义验证和相关性引导重采样构成的工具增强闭环搜索，从而在提升长视频问答性能的同时避免不必要的工具计算。

papers.title: The Visual Bottleneck: Sparse-Frame Adaptation of MLLMs for Joint Spatial-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Jiameng Zhang, Srikanth Madikeri
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了稀疏帧输入下多模态大语言模型进行时空视频定位的训练策略，发现视觉特征提取是主要瓶颈，仅微调最后三层ViT（4%参数）即可大幅超越零样本密集输入的8B模型，并提出了边界感知采样策略Hybrid16。

papers.title: TimePLE: Rethinking Temporal Representation for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Yuhui Zeng, Xinyu Mao, Xiaokun Liu, Xin Tao, Jinfa Huang, Jiayi Ji, Xiawu Zheng
papers.affiliations: Media Analytics and Computing Lab, Xiamen University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; Department of Computer Science, University of Rochester; Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology
papers.intro: TimePLE通过将视频时间定位从端点预测重构为区间本位预测，利用VLM生成的单个<|TIMESPAN|> token在规范位置-时长平方上解码出一个联合区间分布，从而直接输出连续时间边界。

papers.title: LabRobFail: A Benchmark for Robotic Failure Analysis in Chemical Self-driving Laboratories
papers.authors: Haobo Wang, Baoli Sun, Anqi Zou, Dongsheng Huang, Zelin Lv, Ning Wang, Rui Li, Dongzhan Zhou, Weiyu Guo, Zhihui Wang, Wanli Ouyang
papers.affiliations: Dalian University of Technology, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出LabRobFail——一个面向化学自驱动实验室机器人失败分析的框架，包含可控失败注入的仿真平台、大规模多类型失败数据集（超20,000条轨迹、11种细粒度失败类型）以及六维度评估基准，并开发了领域专用VLM实现结构化失败诊断与恢复，显著提升下游任务成功率。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM3 for Prompt-Driven Surgical Concept Segmentation
papers.authors: Changjing Liu, Yiming Huang, Beilei Cui, Liangjing Shao, Long Bai, Yanheng Li, Haoxuan Che, Hongliang Ren
papers.affiliations: 1 Department of Electronic Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China; 2 XGEN Labs
papers.intro: 本文提出一种参数高效的LoRA适配方法，仅更新SAM3中0.98%的参数（训练内存降至9GB），在多个手术数据集上显著优于零样本SAM3和全微调Medical SAM3，并直接支撑下游手术场景重建与物理仿真。

papers.title: Perturbation-Aware Diffusion-Guided Hybrid Segmentation for Robust and Annotation-Efficient Plant Stress Phenotyping
papers.authors: Gurbhit Chaurakoti, Soumyashree Kar
papers.affiliations: National Institute of Technology Delhi（Gurbhit Chaurakoti）；Indian Institute of Technology Bombay（Soumyashree Kar）
papers.intro: 提出一种扩散引导的混合分割框架，通过U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer骨干与DDPM、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散三种细化器配对，结合扰动感知的重训练策略和边界约束优化，在资源受限条件下实现了对植物胁迫图像的鲁棒且标注高效的分割。

papers.title: Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation
papers.authors: Yu Zhang, Wenda Zhao, Haojun Tang, Haipeng Wang
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Yu Zhang, Wenda Zhao, Haojun Tang - School of Information and Communication Engineering, Dalian University of Technology; Haipeng Wang - Unit 92728 of PLA, Shanghai
papers.intro: 本文提出对比参数解缠框架（CPD），通过利用LoRA参数的功能二分性在正交核心子空间内实现语义与模态属性的参数级解缠，并结合查询-键结构转移机制，实现从单一文本提示生成语义一致、结构对齐的高保真多模态遥感图像。

papers.title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes
papers.authors: Junyue Li, Ye Zheng, Yifan Chen, Zhe Sun, Xuelong Li
papers.affiliations: 未明确（各作者所属机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: RRTrack提出一种无需训练的可恢复物体6D姿态跟踪框架，通过2D-6D闭环跟踪（结合视频物体分割和CAD模型精化）和DINOv2双库模板匹配，在快速运动和遮挡消失-重现场景下实现鲁棒跟踪，并在合成基准上相比FoundationPose将ADD-S AR提升66.3%、AUC提升65.7%。

papers.title: WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification
papers.authors: Junfei Shi, Haojia Zhang, Yu Cheng, Yuke Li
papers.intro: 本文提出WGDNet，一种融合可学习Wishart统计建模、方向先验引导聚合和几何自适应卷积的端到端PolSAR图像分类网络。

papers.title: PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology
papers.authors: Jingzhi Chen, Landi He, Zehong Chen, Peihang Wu, Lijian Xu
papers.intro: 本文提出PathSelect，一个将WSI令牌剪枝重新定义为门控顺序选择的可学习框架，通过可微分的软Top-K与噪声门控结合对角线注意力去噪器实现端到端连续优化，在冻结SlideChat模型基础上实现36.6倍令牌压缩且准确率超越采样基准。
